warnings: This is a private debt-collection agency's demand letter, not a court order or enforceable title; before paying, verify directly with the original creditor (Beispielnetz Kabel GmbH) that the underlying invoices for August and September 2026 are genuinely unpaid and that the amounts (including the Mahngebühr and the RVG-capped Inkassovergütung) are correctly calculated.

Double-check that the IBAN given (the Inkassobüro's Treuhandkonto, DE20 3705 0198 0005 5664 00) is correct and genuinely belongs to this collection agency before transferring any money, as collection-letter scams sometimes use fake or altered bank details.

The letter contains no Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung and sets no formal objection deadline; if you dispute the claim, do so promptly in writing with reasons, ideally well before the 02.12.2026 payment date, to avoid further dunning or legal action.
